description: Test suite file for sessions-access.js and related session visibility logic, written in TypeScript using Vitest. Contains unit tests for session visibility resolution, sandbox contexts, agent-to-agent policies, and session guards.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite block for grouping related tests.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that a value matches an expected condition.

methods.name: vi.fn
methods.description: Creates a mock function for testing purposes.

methods.name: createAgentToAgentPolicy
methods.description: Creates a policy object to control cross-agent messaging permissions.

methods.name: createSessionVisibilityGuard
methods.description: Creates a guard that enforces session visibility rules based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Determines the effective visibility setting for session tools, considering sandbox restrictions.

methods.name: resolveSandboxSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Resolves the default visibility clamp for sandboxed session tools.

methods.name: resolveSandboxedSessionToolContext
methods.description: Generates context information for sandboxed sessions, including restrictions.

methods.name: resolveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Resolves the visibility setting for session tools based on configuration.
